en.headline: 405 own commits and 715 automated commits across 12 repositories
en.teaser: Most work went into the daily-summary pipeline, an OpenCode agent sandbox, skill management, a translation extension and pixel logo tooling, plus issue reports to OpenChamber and OpenCode.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-11 to 2026-11-09 with data for every day. Across all repositories the account recorded 405 own commits plus 715 automated commits, 34 issue actions and no pull requests or reviews.

### Daily summary pipeline

Most of the effort went into `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, where the daily report generator was reworked. The AI layer no longer swallows empty days, discussion sections survive blank days, and commits are attributed through aliases so non-GitHub emails are counted. A new AI summary of the last 30 days of GitHub activity was added as a home-page card and a separate page, and a `--force` flag lets closed dates be re-collected.

### OpenCode tooling

Two OpenCode projects advanced in parallel. `opencode-agent-sandbox` built up a knowledge base covering OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture, authentication and Windows path pitfalls, with corrections to stale conclusions. `opencode-skill-management` implemented the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, shipped release candidates and then v0.2.0, v1.0.0, v1.1.0 and v1.2.0, the last moving all actions to a single JSON object output.

### Translation and pixel art

`sopen-translate` was started from scratch: an MV3 skeleton, a provider protocol layer with presets and a glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting and a circuit breaker, plus smoke tests and JSDoc type checking. `pixel-logo-toolkit` gained automatic text wrapping with overflow protection, a bilingual CLI, an English-first README and a 40-image command gallery, releasing v0.2.0 and v0.3.0.

### Model picker and reports

`opencode-go-model-picker` shipped v1.4.0, v2.0.0, v3.0.0 and v3.0.1, covering shared script helpers, fuller agent discovery, priced accounting math and a large documentation reduction. `dsh-ecosystem-report` received mobile viewport fixes, a reworked theme switcher and a GitHub repository button, while `asset-inventory` corrected skill invocation facts and released v1.15.4 and v1.15.5.

### Upstream reports

Outside the account's own repositories, issue activity went to `openchamber/openchamber` and `anomalyco/opencode`, covering storage management, MCP settings, session retention hints, quote-card navigation, file-view commenting, context panel breakdowns, browser capture resolution and MiMo vision handling. One issue was opened against `microsoft/PowerToys` about a Shortcut Guide NullReferenceException.

highlights.text: Commented on the AI narrative generation failure tracking issue.
First stable release of the skill_management plugin, freezing the 1.x surface.
Simplified the skill to two Markdown files, cutting the read size by roughly 92 percent.
Added automatic text wrapping and overflow protection with a full CLI manual.
Opened a bug report that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server added at runtime.
Opened and later closed a report that the Go endpoint rejects images for MiMo models.
Opened a Shortcut Guide report about a NullReferenceException on Hold-Win activation.
Started an idea discussion about commenting on selected code in the Files view.

byRepo.text: 113 own commits plus 715 automated commits, with 6 issue actions. Work centered on the daily report generator: removing the duplicate empty gate in the AI layer, keeping discussion sections on blank days, flagging truncation when collection hits its cap, supporting commit attribution aliases, and adding a `--force` flag. A new AI summary of the last 30 days of GitHub activity was added as a home-page card and a standalone page.

84 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions. The repository grew a knowledge base for OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture, authentication and Windows path pitfalls, plus notes on oh-my-opencode-slim and hosted OpenCode tests. Later commits corrected outdated conclusions about subcommand lists, bundled skill counts and Windows ports, and added remote branch deletion checks.

77 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions, and four releases: v0.2.0, v1.0.0, v1.1.0 and v1.2.0. The `skill_management` plugin was implemented with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, verified through release candidates published via trusted publishing, then moved to a single JSON object output with a declared schema in v1.1.0 and fixed divergent-agent counting in v1.2.0.

56 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions. The repository was initialized and built into an MV3 extension: a provider protocol layer with presets, model list and glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting, a circuit breaker and progress reporting, then a refactor dropping selection translation. Smoke tests, required-field validation and JSDoc type checking were added.

29 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions, and two releases: v0.2.0 and v0.3.0. Text wrapping and overflow protection were added, the CLI became bilingual with an English-first README, a 40-image command gallery was documented, and fixes covered Korean font selection, width reservation for right-side decorations and pure query commands without Pillow.

25 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions, and four releases: v1.4.0, v2.0.0, v3.0.0 and v3.0.1. Scripts gained shared JSON and proxy helpers, agent discovery reported mode, hidden and traits fields, priced accounting math was introduced in 2.0.0, and 3.0.0 cut the documentation to two Markdown files. Version drift checks and atomic snapshot writes followed.

No own commits, no automated commits, no releases, and 16 issue actions. Reports covered storage management for task temp files, the missing Console MCP server in settings, an outdated session retention hint, a silent no-op quote-card arrow, unreliable line-number dragging in the Files view, a context panel breakdown that always showed 0 percent, and browser captures exported at 1x resolution. Several idea discussions were also started.

No own commits, no automated commits, no releases, and 11 issue actions. Activity focused on MiMo models on the Go endpoint: images advertised but rejected with 400, stale image reads after several images in one session, and subagent failures with model_coming_soon. A feature request asked for a way to run the CLI shipped with the Windows desktop app.

11 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions. Mobile fixes made table cards fill the width and adapted the layout to 375 and 414 pixel viewports, the theme switcher became a single button with a popup menu, and visual polish added gradient top lines, KPI color bars and zebra striping. Three plugins were merged into the resource list and a GitHub repository button was added.

6 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions, and two releases: v1.15.4 and v1.15.5. The work corrected skill invocation facts across the rule, samples, quick-start fences and guides, removed stale slash command references from the skill and contributor docs, and fixed Japanese localization.

4 own commits, no automated commits, no issue actions. All four commits added OpenChamber capture samples: a desktop 1440x900 screenshot, a 1:1 panel region image, a mobile 390x844 screenshot and a session retention hint screenshot.

No own commits, no automated commits, no releases, and 1 issue action. The single action opened a Shortcut Guide report that Hold-Win activation throws a NullReferenceException and shows nothing when the runner process cannot be inspected.

zh.headline: 12 个仓库共 405 次本人提交，另有 715 次自动提交
zh.teaser: 主要工作集中在日报生成流程、OpenCode 沙箱与技能管理、翻译扩展和像素 Logo 工具，同时向 OpenChamber 与 OpenCode 提交了若干问题报告。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-11 至 2026-11-09，30 天均有数据。全部仓库合计 405 次本人提交，另有 715 次自动提交，34 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论），没有拉取请求和评审记录。

### 日报生成流程

投入最多的是 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`，日报生成器被大幅调整。AI 层不再重复拦截空白日，空白日也不会吞掉 discussion 等附加段，提交归属支持别名以兼容非 GitHub 邮箱。新增了近 30 天 GitHub 活动的 AI 总结，包含首页卡片和独立页面，并加入 `--force` 参数以便重跑已关闭日期。

### OpenCode 工具链

两个 OpenCode 项目并行推进。`opencode-agent-sandbox` 建立了知识库，记录 OpenCode V2 的分发、架构、认证和 Windows 路径问题，并修正了过期结论。`opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，经过发布候选后依次发布 v0.2.0、v1.0.0、v1.1.0 和 v1.2.0，最后一版把输出统一为单个 JSON 对象。

### 翻译扩展与像素工具

`sopen-translate` 从零搭建：MV3 骨架、带预设和术语表的 provider 协议层、支持分块与熔断的双语页面渲染，并补充冒烟测试和 JSDoc 类型检查。`pixel-logo-toolkit` 增加了文本自动折行与溢出保护、双语命令行、英文优先的 README 和 40 张命令示例画廊，并发布 v0.2.0 与 v0.3.0。

### 模型选择器与报告页

`opencode-go-model-picker` 发布 v1.4.0、v2.0.0、v3.0.0 和 v3.0.1，涉及脚本公共辅助函数、更完整的 agent 发现、计价核算公式以及文档大幅精简。`dsh-ecosystem-report` 修复了移动端视口适配，重做了主题切换并加入 GitHub 仓库按钮；`asset-inventory` 修正了技能调用说明，并发布 v1.15.4 与 v1.15.5。

### 上游问题反馈

在自有仓库之外，issue 互动集中在 `openchamber/openchamber` 和 `anomalyco/opencode`，涉及存储管理、MCP 设置、会话保留提示、引用卡片跳转、文件视图评论、上下文面板占比、浏览器截图分辨率以及 MiMo 视觉处理。另向 `microsoft/PowerToys` 提交了一个关于快捷指南 NullReferenceException 的报告。

highlights.text: 在 AI 叙述生成失败的跟踪 issue 下发表了评论。
skill_management 插件首个稳定版发布，冻结 1.x 的接口范围。
技能文档精简为两个 Markdown 文件，阅读量减少约 92%。
加入文本自动折行与溢出保护，并补齐命令行手册。
提交缺陷报告：设置中的 MCP 页面缺少运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
提交并随后关闭了 Go 端点拒绝 MiMo 模型图片输入的报告。
提交快捷指南在 Hold-Win 激活时抛出 NullReferenceException 的报告。
发起关于在文件视图中对选中代码评论的想法讨论。

byRepo.text: 113 次本人提交，另有 715 次自动提交，6 次 issue 互动。工作围绕日报生成器展开：移除 AI 层重复的空内容拦截，空白日保留 discussion 等段落，采集命中上限时标注截断，支持提交归属别名，并新增 `--force` 参数。还加入了近 30 天 GitHub 活动的 AI 总结，包含首页卡片和独立页面。
84 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动。仓库建立了知识库，记录 OpenCode V2 的分发、架构、认证与 Windows 路径问题，以及 oh-my-opencode-slim 和托管 OpenCode 的实测结论。后续提交修正了子命令列表、随包技能数量和 Windows 端口等过期结论，并补充远程分支删除的检查与风险。

77 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动，共发布 v0.2.0、v1.0.0、v1.1.0、v1.2.0 四个版本。实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 动作，经发布候选验证 trusted publishing 后转为稳定版；v1.1.0 把输出改为带 schema 的单个 JSON 对象，v1.2.0 修复了跨 agent 差异统计的误报。
56 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动。仓库从初始化开始搭建 MV3 扩展：带预设、模型列表和术语表的 provider 协议层，支持分块、熔断和进度显示的双语页面渲染，随后重构去掉划词翻译。还补充了冒烟测试、必填字段校验和 JSDoc 类型检查。
29 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动，共发布 v0.2.0 和 v0.3.0。新增文本自动折行与溢出保护，命令行改为中英双语，README 拆为英文默认版并新增 40 张命令示例画廊。修复包括韩语改用 Galmuri 字体、右侧装饰的宽度让位，以及缺少 Pillow 时纯查询命令仍可用。
25 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动，共发布 v1.4.0、v2.0.0、v3.0.0、v3.0.1 四个版本。脚本加入共享的 JSON 与代理辅助函数，agent 发现补充 mode、hidden、traits 字段，2.0.0 引入计价核算公式，3.0.0 把文档压缩到两个 Markdown 文件。之后又加入版本漂移检查和快照原子写入。
无本人提交，无自动提交，无发布，16 次 issue 互动。报告涉及任务临时文件的存储管理、设置中缺失 Console MCP 服务器、过期的会话保留提示、引用卡片箭头无响应、文件视图拖动行号评论不稳定、上下文面板占比恒为 0，以及浏览器截图按 1 倍分辨率导出。此外还发起了若干想法讨论。
无本人提交，无自动提交，无发布，11 次 issue 互动。内容集中在 Go 端点上的 MiMo 模型：声明支持图片却被 400 拒绝、单次会话多图后读取旧图、子代理报 model_coming_soon。另有一条功能请求，希望 Windows 桌面版自带的 CLI 能有运行入口。
11 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动。移动端修复让表格卡片占满宽度，并适配 375 和 414 像素视口；主题切换改为单按钮加弹出菜单；视觉上加入渐变顶线、KPI 色条和斑马纹。资料库清单并入 3 个插件，并新增 GitHub 仓库按钮。
6 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动，共发布 v1.15.4 和 v1.15.5。工作修正了规则、示例、快速开始代码块和指南中的技能调用说明，从技能与贡献者文档中移除过期的斜杠命令引用，并修复了日语本地化。
4 次本人提交，无自动提交，无 issue 互动。四次提交均为添加 OpenChamber 截图素材：桌面 1440x900 截图、1:1 面板区域图、移动端 390x844 截图，以及会话保留提示截图。
无本人提交，无自动提交，无发布，1 次 issue 互动。该操作提交了一份快捷指南报告：Hold-Win 激活时抛出 NullReferenceException，且在无法检查运行进程时不显示任何内容。
